Next, I should consider the rabbit's well-being. Rabbits are herbivores and need a diet rich in fiber, which is why they usually get salads. It's important to trust and follow the advice of medical professionals, especially when it comes to the health of a pet. So, putting it all together, the decision to not feed the rabbit tonight seems to be the right choice because it aligns with medical advice aimed at ensuring the rabbit's safety during surgery.
